question.prompt: Aunt Anna is \(42\) years old. Caitlin is \(5\) years younger than Brianna, and Brianna is half as old as Aunt Anna. How old is Caitlin?

solutions.explanation: Brianna is half as old as Aunt Anna, so Brianna is \(42\div2=21\) years old. Caitlin is \(5\) years younger than Brianna, so Caitlin is \(21-5=16\) years old, choice B.
solutions.title: Find Brianna's age first
